facts: Within hours of the September 11, 2001, attack on the World Trade Center, specially trained dogs were on the scene, including German Shepherds, Labs, and even a few little Dachshunds.
The earliest dog fossil dates back to nearly 10,000 B.C.
The famous nickname, "man’s best friend," is used in many other languages as well as English.
Dogs can be trained to detect cancer in humans.
The average dog can run at speeds of up to 19mph.
